$comment: Round 8 (docs/round-8-contract.md §1): THE Canvas contract, replayed by the engine (apps/desktop/crates/eui-motion/tests/canvas.rs; gpui paints these lists), the TS core over the WASM CanvasPlayer (src/canvas.test.ts) and the Swift and Kotlin painters over uniffi. AUTO-GENERATED expected values: `UPDATE_CANVAS_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p eui-motion --test canvas` (inputs kept). A Canvas node's `{size, shapes}` compiles (eui-motion `canvas::Canvas::compile`) into a ONE-FRAME Motion and samples into the Motion display list (fixtures/motion-frames.json documents every op) plus `text` ops. `compile`: `canvas` = the node's {size, shapes}, `slots` (optional) = the host's slot overrides, exactly a Motion player's (`$color.<token>` → {p: {a: 0, k: [r, g, b, a]}} from the theme, `$mode`: dark picks the dark half of {light, dark} pairs); expected `slotIds` = every slot the canvas declares (sorted: the token slots a host fills, `ld:<light>:<dark>` pairs), `list` (serde JSON) and `packed` (the f32 stream, VERSION 2). THE TEXT RULE: every `text` op comes after every other op (after the frame's final `pop`), in SOURCE order, whatever the shapes around it; {op: text, transform, text, font: sans|mono, weight: regular|medium|semibold|bold, size, align: start|center|end, baseline: top|middle|alphabetic, color}: the anchor is the op's local origin, so a painter maps (0, 0) through fit × transform and sets ONE line (never wrapped; a line break in the source became a space) at font px `size` × the transform's scale, in the theme's `$type.family.sans` / `$type.family.mono` at that CSS weight; `align` = where x is: start = the line's left edge, center = its middle, end = its right edge (physical: a drawing never mirrors); `baseline` = where y is: top = baseline at y + ascent, middle = baseline at y + (ascent − descent) / 2, alphabetic = the baseline (ascent, descent = the font's own hhea ascender and descender magnitudes at that size, what every native text system reports; no leading); the colour is straight RGBA, the groups' opacity already multiplied into alpha. Packed text: 7, t[6], font (0 sans, 1 mono), weight (400, 500, 600, 700), size, align (0 start, 1 center, 2 end), baseline (0 top, 1 middle, 2 alphabetic), r, g, b, a, n, then n UTF-16 code units. Text is never outlined by the engine and the tiny-skia reference skips it (the gpui painter rasters the shapes, then draws native text on top). `refuse`: the expected `issues` [{code, path, message}]; a replay compares `code` and `path` (in order), the message is the engine's: `canvas-animated` (any `{keys}`: a Canvas is static, Motion animates), `canvas-shape-type` (outside rect, ellipse, star, polygon, path, fill, stroke, gradient-fill, trim, repeater, round-corners, group, text), `canvas-lottie` (raw `lottie` keys), `canvas-text` (a text field), `color`, `size`, `shapes`, the dialect's own codes with their paths under /shapes, and the budget: `limit-ops` (ops per frame > limits.json canvas.maxOps), `limit-texts` (> canvas.maxTexts), `limit-text` (characters > canvas.maxTextChars), `limit-shapes` / `limit-bytes` (the Motion limits on the compiled one-frame Lottie; vertices are not counted, as for a Motion). `fit`: drawing `size` [w, h] in a `box` [w, h] px under `fit` → the `matrix` [a, b, c, d, e, f] (drawing units → box px): contain = uniform min(bw/w, bh/h) centred, cover = uniform max(…) centred (the overflow clipped by the box), fill = bw/w, bh/h from the top-left. `pointer`: what `press` / `move` carry with `pointer: true`: a point `at` [x, y] box px (relative to the Canvas box's top-left) → `drawing` [x, y] = the fit mapping inverted, rounded to two decimals (compare within 0.01); a point in a contain letterbox maps outside 0..size, never clamped.

compile.covers: star + polygon, each filled (styles paint every shape before them in their group)
path d (M L H V C S Q T A Z, relative + absolute) + stroke round caps
gradient-fill linear and radial (stops with alpha)
trim (start/end percent) on a stroked line
group transform (anchor, position, scale, rotation, opacity) applies to its shapes AND its text: the text op's transform = the groups' matrices × translate(position), its alpha × the groups' opacity
$color tokens without host slots: shapes and text show the placeholder grey; slotIds lists every token
$color tokens filled by the host's slot overrides ({"p": {"a": 0, "k": rgba}}), a {light, dark} pair under $mode dark; the default text colour is $color.foreground

every weight, align, baseline and font; text ops come AFTER every shape op in SOURCE order (the first text is written before the shapes); a line break becomes a space; packed text = code 7, t[6], font, weight (CSS), size, align, baseline, rgba, UTF-16 length, code units (an emoji = 2 units)
a small bar chart: axis line, three bars (one group each), value labels centred above the bars, category labels under them
no shapes: the frame is the composition clip and its pop, then the text

refuse.covers: an animated {keys} value anywhere in a shape
